content: शम्ब(म्भ) {%a.%} [शम्ब् अच्] .²1 Happy, fortunate. .²2 Poor, unfortunate. .{@-म्बः@} , .({@-म्भः@}) .²1 The thunderbolt of Indra. .²2 The iron head of a pestle. .²3 An iron chain worn round the loins. .²4 Ploughing ‘with the grain’ or in the regular direction. .²5 The second ploughing of a field. .²6 A particular measure of length. (शम्बाकृ means ‘to plough twice’; त्वया शम्बाकृतं क्षतम् <ls>N. 20. 83</ls>, doubly pierced).
